text: やまおとこに　びびらずに　たたかうとは　たいした　もんだ！

structure.jp: やまおとこに　びびらずに

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ずに on a verb means 'without doing' it. びびらずに = 'without getting scared'.

patterns.name: 〜とは
patterns.explanation: とは after a verb shows the speaker is surprised or impressed by that action. たたかうとは = 'to think that you'd battle'.

patterns.name: 〜ものだ
patterns.explanation: ものだ at the end adds feeling, here admiration; もん is the casual spoken form of もの. たいした　もんだ = 'that's really something'.
